title: Trust rotation can commit on disk while reporting failure and rolling memory back
description: CORRECTNESS: TrustStore.rotate_key mutates the in-memory snapshot, calls TrustStorePersistence.save, and on any exception restores the old in-memory entry/revision. But TrustStorePersistence._write_json_locked performs os.replace before chmod and directory fsync. If either post-replace operation raises, save reports failure even though trust_store.json already contains the rotated key and advanced revision. rotate_key then restores old memory, so runtime and durable trust disagree; restart accepts a rotation the caller was told failed, and subsequent saves fail stale-revision CAS. Treat the post-replace state as an indeterminate/terminal persistence transition or redesign commit/reconciliation so an exception cannot produce a durable new snapshot with old live memory. Add injected chmod/directory-fsync failure tests around public rotation.
close_reason: Fix verified: indeterminate/terminal post-replace transition already committed in 95d85c3747 (_write_json_locked replaced-flag, TrustStorePersistenceIndeterminateError, save() revision/terminal handling, _commit_security_mutation durable_state_may_have_advanced honoring). Audit traced all paths: pre-replace failures roll back memory with disk untouched; post-replace chmod/open/fsync and post-write anchor failures keep memory==disk and poison the backend as terminal, so stale-CAS divergence is impossible. Added missing tests in python/tests/crypto/test_key_persistence.py: test_rotation_after_indeterminate_failure_is_terminal_not_stale (chmod+directory_fsync parametrized; subsequent rotate raises terminal TrustError not stale-CAS; memory/disk stay in agreement) and test_pre_replace_rotation_failure_keeps_disk_and_memory_old (os.replace injection; disk old + memory old; no staging leftovers; retry succeeds durably). Mutation-checked: reverting _commit_security_mutation to unconditional rollback makes all post-replace tests fail, so they bite. 124 passed in test_key_persistence.py + test_trust.py; ruff clean.
